title: The productivity hack that Silicon Valley keeps secret

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the biggest productivity hack isn’t a tool, but a shift in how we interact with AI?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We’re seeing real-time AI collaboration tools, like code co-pilots and automated task orchestration, already in use at top tech firms.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks deepening inequality — only those with access to these tools will thrive, while others are left behind.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source AI frameworks and cloud-based platforms are making these tools more accessible to smaller teams and startups.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI distributes productivity gains broadly, not just to the elite, through shared infrastructure and education.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about smarter tools — it’s about building systems that lift everyone up.

video_cue: A diverse group of people working together with AI assistants in a collaborative, modern workspace.
